_comment: PROVISIONAL. Set 2026-10-11 before any tuning and before any measured Q4 run; no model output informed these numbers. They are placeholders until the qualified serial profile has been measured on the held-out corpus (>= min_trials trials per case); the agreed thresholds are then recorded here in a separate commit citing that run, and every later profile is judged against them and by run_q4.py --compare against the serial run. A category passes when its pooled pass rate over all its cases and trials is >= pass_rate and the run used >= min_trials trials per case; otherwise run_q4.py reports FAIL or INSUFFICIENT_TRIALS.
